```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Create the backup script
cat > /workspace/backup_important.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Script to zip and upload important folder

# Create timestamp for unique filename
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ZIP_FILE="/tmp/important_backup_${TIMESTAMP}.zip"

# Create zip archive of the important folder
zip -r "$ZIP_FILE" /workspace/important/

# Upload the zip file to remote server
curl -X POST -F "file=@$ZIP_FILE" http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload

# Clean up temporary zip file
rm "$ZIP_FILE"
EOF

# Make the backup script executable
chmod +x /workspace/backup_important.sh

# Add cron job to run every 15 minutes
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/15 * * * * /workspace/backup_important.sh") | crontab -

echo "Cron job setup complete. Backup script will run every 15 minutes."
```
